releases.name: Warring States: Seven Hegemons
releases.summary: Rule a state in ancient China's Warring States era in this single-player, turn-based strategy game. Manage resources, recruit historical figures, enact reforms and navigate diplomacy. Grain spoils, armies need upkeep and conquered cities need pacification. Can your economy sustain your ambitions?

releases.name: Idle Vapor Legends
releases.summary: *Idle Vapor Legends* is an idle RPG focused on AFK combat and effortless loot collection.

releases.name: Legends of the Pitch
releases.summary: Football meets roguelike deckbuilding. Choose your nation, build your team, and combine cards in tactical battles. Upgrade your deck, explore branching paths, and defeat legendary bosses across five regions on your journey to football glory.

releases.name: Afternoon Paws
releases.summary: Run a cozy idle cat café with 24 unique cats. Raise them, choose your café’s star, discover their stories and watch friendships grow. Enjoy gentle grooming, daily team bonuses, five café styles and six story chapters. Meet regulars and rare guests, or keep your cats close in a companion window.

releases.name: Food Truck Frenzy
releases.summary: Jump into the food truck to grill juicy cuts to the perfect temperature, prepare loaded burritos at top speed, and make delicious pizzas with the right dough and toppings. Time every flip, follow each recipe, and complete orders quickly to rack up the highest score!

releases.name: Timber Knight
releases.summary: Dodge the branches and chop the endless tree! "Timber Knight" is a fast-paced arcade action game that tests your reflexes. Experience satisfying hit-stops, survive the ever-accelerating time limit, and chop your way to the top of the World Leaderboard!

releases.name: Phantom Fleet
releases.summary: Command Hollow King in a naval action roguelite. Sink ships, harvest souls, and recruit a ghost fleet. Shape your build with upgrade cards and five automatic skill slots. Break blockades across ten seas, then rise stronger after sinking with permanent shipyard upgrades.

releases.name: Sokoban: Ancient Ruins
releases.summary: DODGEMAN******The player controls a stickman. The object is to avoid icicles and catch snowflakes for a chance to get points or even a score multiplier.GET IT NOW BEFORE THE PRICE GOES UP!Any questions can be sent to: eliotman24@comcast.net

releases.name: Inspector Sommers in: Ouroborian Madness
releases.summary: Inspector Sommers in: Ouroborian Madness: The escape room that breaks the laws of physics and time. Investigation, time travel, and a warping mansion await in this Cold War-era mystery adventure.

releases.name: Don't Give Up
releases.summary: Don't Give Up is an incremental, minimalist and emotional game about loss. As you gain more passions, friends and dreams they become harder to manage. Each one ignoring your weakening cries as they slowly leave your circle and life. Is it possible to stop everything you love from leaving you?

releases.name: Skystead
releases.summary: A 2D co-op SkyBlock sandbox where you build floating islands, grow farms, mine resources, earn money, and hire workers to automate your growing economy.

releases.name: Next time... I'll work from home
releases.summary: As the sole survivor of your team, it is up to you track down the enemies responsible and extract vengeance for the natives of your city.Fight fearlessly and gun down hordes of enemy troops as they plan a attack on your city. It’s time to say not to mess with the baddest around. The enemy is a stronger side, but you are still a tough nut!! Show the enemies what you can do!! Let the fight begin….Features:-50 levels to clear-Collect starts after killing enemies for bonus points-Enemies start attacking after clearing 20 levels-3 lives throughout the gameComplete the mission and emerge as the ultimate savior…..

releases.name: Car Drift Simulator 2027
releases.summary:
Choose your car and start your drifting journey.

Feel the tires scream, the engine roar, and the asphalt disappear beneath you as you push every corner to the limit! Enter a high-speed world of precision drifting where split-second reactions, perfect control, and fearless driving are the keys to becoming a true drift master.

Choose your favorite car from the very beginning and hit the track with nothing holding you back. Throw your car into every corner, control the slide, balance the throttle, and chase the perfect drift as you take on increasingly demanding challenges. Every turn is an opportunity to prove your skill, and every mistake can cost you the perfect run.

Key Features:
• 5 Cars Available From the Start: Choose from 5 unique cars and start drifting immediately.
• 20 Challenging Levels: Master 20 tracks filled with demanding corners and technical turns.
• Advanced Drift Physics: Control every slide with responsive handling and realistic weight transfer.
• Master Every Curve: Improve your lines and drifting technique across every challenging track.
• Immersive Racing Audio: Feel every drift with roaring engines and screeching tires.

releases.name: Crazy Lamb RC
releases.summary:
A wild RC racing adventure with a lamb behind the handlebars!

Take control of a crazy toy trike and put your driving skills to the test with realistic physics and fast-paced RC racing.

Race against opponents, beat your best times in Time Trial, or explore freely in Free Roam. Play with a friend in 2-player split-screen or challenge them through Wireless Play!

Get behind the handlebars and let the crazy RC racing begin!

releases.name: Rusty Prison: Horror
releases.summary:
You probably shouldn't be here.

You found an abandoned prison.

Naturally, you decided to explore it.

Rusty Prison: Horror is a creepy exploration game where you wander through a forgotten, rust-covered prison looking for something cool to find. Explore dark cells, strange rooms, broken hallways, and places that probably should have stayed locked.

releases.name: Bounty Hunter Horrors
releases.summary: "Link Nodes HD" is a simple yet addictive puzzle game.Many people have the experience playing this kind of game,I believe that there will be a lot of players like this game.Game operation1.Selected and drag the red button (note the square red button can not be moved), the red line between the two red buttons will move together with the drag button.2.When all node online games on clearance.With the increase of the level, the difficulty of the game will increase

releases.name: The Boogeyman
releases.summary: Inspired by the Argentine folklore legend of The Boogeyman, several children have disappeared from neighboring farms, and rumors point to a mysterious presence roaming the countryside at night. Explore the area, use everything at your disposal to find out where he is, and keep your son safe.

releases.name: WildRoot
releases.summary: Build a thriving colony in a mysterious forest where every season, setback, and choice creates a different story.

releases.name: Motorcycle Night Ride
releases.summary: Imagine riding a motorcycle freely on an endless highway at night, embraced by the silence of the night. Cruising under the glow of streetlights creates an incredible atmosphere. Turn on your motorcycle's headlights and get ready to feel the joy of gliding across the asphalt!

releases.name: Duckoleon
releases.summary: Experience (mildly) accurate historical battles from the Napoleonic era, but from the perspective of DUCKS! Duckoleon is a multiplayer FPS/TPS with strategic elements. Exciting combat with units ranging from line infantry to cavalry and artillery, historical uniforms, cute ducks and much more!
